fichas.title: Parking Facilities: Vehicles—Cars
fichas.summary: Reference sheet showing typical bicycle, motorcycle, and car dimensions, turning radii, and vehicle weights for space requirements and regulations for garages, parking spaces, and access and exit driveways. Dimensions are shown in metres and weights in tonnes.
